request: Keep the white car in colour, turn everything else grey.
driver_said:
The car is white (no hue to key on), so the right tool is the spatial one: isolate the car object and desaturate everything else. First let me check the segmentation actually finds the car inside a box around it. The segmentation cleanly found the car (66.6% of the box), including wheels, windows and mirror. Now I'll keep the car in colour and desaturate everything else. Done. I used object-level isolation rather than a hue-based approach — the car is white, so there's no colour to key on; instead I segmented the car itself and desaturated everything outside it:

- **The car** (body, windows, mirror, wheels, the small red side-marker and amber indicators) keeps its original colour.
- **Everything else** — wall, vegetation, ground, kerb — is now grey.

The verification note confirms ~85% of the car retained its colour while only ~1% outside did, and the result matches visually.
